name: g65_water_bubble
purpose: Water Bubble (step G65): Liquidation (Water, physical) on Skeledirge is doubled and Torch Song (Fire, special) on Araquanid is halved (step 1); then Will-O-Wisp on Araquanid is refused with the -immune line, and Flare Blitz (Fire) does half damage to it with its burn refused silently (step 2). The control is the same with Water Absorb.
